purpose: Compact guide index thumbnail; article hero unchanged
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square index thumbnail for a China procurement guide. Generate a new 1024 by 1024 square image, an elegant photorealistic studio object illustration with one large, simple, centered subject occupying roughly 80 percent of the square. Plain light warm ivory seamless background, soft directional studio light and a short soft contact shadow. Restrained warm-neutral palette, tactile realistic materials, crisp broad silhouette recognizable when reduced to 80 pixels. Deliberately simpler than an editorial hero photograph. No people, hands, faces, room scene, background props, collage, split screen, frame, writing, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, screenshots, certificates or decorative graphics. Subject: a single bundle of four matching turned walnut dining-chair legs, lying diagonally from lower left to upper right and held together by one broad plain kraft paper band at the center. Three-quarter product photograph, rich clear walnut grain, gently tapered legs with flat squared attachment ends, visibly furniture components rather than firewood. Entire bundle visible, isolated on the light background. No chair, wood shavings, tools, fabric or other objects.
alt: Generated illustration of four walnut chair legs bundled with a plain kraft paper band.
